dict.La inventarierea unei gestiuni: pentru f: When taking stock of a store: for each product, the issues in the period and the allowed rate from the norm give the allowable shortage; the shortage found is split automatically into the part within the norm (booked as an expense) and the part above the norm (in red), to be charged to the stock keeper, with the values in lei and the stocktaking status.
dict.De imputat gestionarului: To be charged to the stock keeper
dict.Ieșirile din perioadă se iau din fișa de: The issues in the period come from the stock card (Sheets → Stock card), from the last stocktaking until today.
dict.Lipsa constatată vine din lista de inven: The shortage found comes from the stocktaking list (Sheets → Stocktaking list); the rates are those in the company's norms, checked with the accountant.
dict.Ce trece peste normă (în roșu) se trece: Anything above the norm (in red) goes into the stocktaking report, with the stock keeper's explanatory note (Docs).
